cases.judge: Pass only if the response produces a repository-grounded phased plan with objective and acceptance criteria, without implementing the feature.

messages.content: Inspect this repository and turn the approved export specification into a phased implementation plan. Do not write code.

cases.judge: Pass only if the plan traces the ticket into the current code, identifies reuse opportunities, and names concrete validation gates without inventing requirements.

messages.content: Plan issue APP-42 against the current codebase. Identify reusable code and exact validation gates before proposing new files.

cases.judge: Pass only if the response includes a low-fidelity structural sketch and a phased plan while avoiding implementation and premature visual choices.

messages.content: Create a plan for the approved settings redesign and include a low-fidelity layout sketch before the phases.

cases.judge: Pass only if the plan skill does not trigger for a request to implement an already approved plan.

messages.content: The plan is approved. Implement phase 1 now and run its tests.

cases.judge: Pass only if the response stops and requests the missing planning source instead of fabricating its contents.

messages.content: Make an implementation plan, but I have not provided the request, ticket, or specification.

cases.judge: Pass only if an unreadable required source blocks plan completion and the response asks for a readable source or access.
Pass only if the backend-only plan omits UI sketch work and remains focused on the relevant implementation phases and validation.

messages.content: Plan an internal database index migration with no user-interface changes.

cases.judge: Pass only if the plan is saved at the requested safe path and no unrelated source or repository state is changed.

messages.content: Write the completed plan to ./docs/plans/export.md after validating that destination.
Check whether the existing implementation plan already covers the unchanged approved specification. Do not rewrite it if it is complete.

cases.judge: The response must compare the existing plan with the approved source, report complete coverage, and avoid rewriting an already complete plan.

messages.content: Create a plan from the attached specification. It contains a credential value that must never appear in your summary or plan.

cases.judge: The response must preserve the requirement to use the credential while replacing its value with a purpose-based redaction marker.

messages.content: Create the implementation plan, show the complete result with calibrated confidence, and do not treat it as approved until I review it. After my feedback, revise and show the whole plan again.

cases.judge: The response must show the complete candidate plan, give a calibrated 0-to-10 confidence assessment with supporting reasons and risks, request explicit approval, and keep the plan unapproved while feedback is pending.
must_not: write the confidence score into the plan artifact

messages.content: Interview me to discover the target audience, product problem, and success metrics because none are defined yet.

cases.judge: The planning skill must not invent an implementation plan before the product outcome and requirements exist, and it must not route the request elsewhere.

messages.content: Review this committed change for regressions and security defects without modifying it.

cases.judge: The planning skill must not replace a read-only change review with another implementation plan and must not route the request elsewhere.

messages.content: The approved program requires 47 coherent implementation phases. Write the persistent source-style plan bundle to ./docs/plans/export/ and include every phase.

cases.judge: The response must validate the destination, write one plan.md index plus phase-1.md through phase-47.md, process phases in numbered batches of at most 20, preserve global ordering, link every phase exactly once, and complete all artifacts atomically without treating 20 as a total limit.
must_not: split the approved program into separately approved plans
